description: List support tickets, optionally filtered by status, priority, and requester.

status.description: Optional status code to filter tickets by (2=open, 3=pending, 4=resolved, 5=closed).

priority.description: Optional priority code to filter tickets by (1=low .. 4=urgent).

requester_id.description: Optional requester (contact) id to filter tickets by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of ticket objects (id, subject, description, status, priority, requester_id, responder_id, type, tags, created_at, updated_at); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single support ticket by its id.

ticket_id.description: The unique id of the ticket.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the ticket object; on failure (ticket not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new support ticket with the supplied fields, applying defaults where omitted.

subject.description: Optional subject line of the ticket (defaults to empty string).

description.description: Optional body description of the ticket (defaults to empty string).

requester_id.description: Optional requester (contact) id for the ticket.

responder_id.description: Optional responder (agent) id assigned to the ticket.

tags.description: Optional list of tag strings for the ticket.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created ticket object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing support ticket by its id.

ticket_id.description: The unique id of the ticket to update.

tags.description: Optional new list of tag strings.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated ticket object; on failure (ticket not found), output contains an error message.

description: List all contacts (requesters) in the current Freshdesk session.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of contact objects (id, name, email, phone, company_id, active, created_at); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List all support agents in the current Freshdesk session.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of agent objects (id, available, ticket_scope, occasional, created_at, contact); on failure, output contains an error message.
